verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for a business payments account, but the evidence pack documents no first-party automation feature. There are no scheduled or recurring transfers, no auto-conversion rules, and no workflow triggers. The closest items are webhooks, batch groups and card spend-control rules. Those are developer building blocks or adjacent controls, so they earn no credit toward self-running automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
